fleet.movement: None may leave Alexandria before Game-Turn 27 OpStage 1; all start armed and undamaged.

reinforcements: Commonwealth reinforcements arrive from the Reinforcement Track as usual except as 61.38 says (61.38).
Replacement points arrive normally, but none may be pre-planned: planning starts in the ordinary course of play, and no replacements at all are allowed for March 1941 (61.38).
The 18th Australian Brigade arrives in Alexandria in the first OpStage of April 1941 and may move by rail, sea or land from the next April OpStage, outside the release limit below (61.38).
special: Tank TOE (61.32): the 3rd Hussars have 3 points of Mk VI light; 5 RTR (3rd Armoured Bde) has 1 point of A9 and 4 of A13; 6 RTR (3rd Armoured Bde) has 5 points of captured M13/40. All start assigned to the 3rd Armoured Brigade.

Release schedule (61.38): nothing in Cairo or Alexandria may move in Game-Turn 26 OpStage 3. From then on only one battalion from there is released each OpStage; a brigade is freed one battalion at a time.

7th Armoured (61.38): its tank battalions are released only once at least 75% repaired, at most one per OpStage, and one non-tank battalion may also be released westward each OpStage; both begin with the first OpStage of April 1941. Its HQs may be released whenever the player likes.
The 22nd Guards Brigade counts as a single battalion for the release schedule (61.38).
Cairo and Alexandria hold unlimited supply, as the standard rules give (61.36).
First-line trucks not carrying men or equipment may start loaded with fuel, ammo, stores and water, in addition to the listed supply (61.36).
